function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => " ")
    return join(c < ' ' ? " " : string(c) for c in s)
end
function sh(cmd::Cmd; t=60, env=nothing)
    out = tempname()
    full = Cmd(vcat(["timeout", string(t)], cmd.exec))
    env === nothing || (full = setenv(full, env))
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(full); stdout=out, stderr=out))
    catch e
        write(out, "EXC " * string(e))
    end
    s = isfile(out) ? read(out, String) : ""
    return last(s, min(length(s), 1500))
end
root = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
mpsdir = joinpath(root, "mps"); mkpath(mpsdir); mkpath(joinpath(mpsdir, "log"))
envs = Dict{String,String}("CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY"=>mpsdir, "CUDA_MPS_LOG_DIRECTORY"=>joinpath(mpsdir,"log"))
E = merge(Dict(ENV), envs)
res = Pair{String,String}[]
push!(res, "which" => (w = Sys.which("nvidia-cuda-mps-control"); w === nothing ? "NOT FOUND" : w))
push!(res, "smi_mode" => sh(`nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,compute_mode,driver_version --format=csv`; t=30))
push!(res, "uid" => sh(`id`; t=10))
if Sys.which("nvidia-cuda-mps-control") !== nothing
    push!(res, "start" => sh(`nvidia-cuda-mps-control -d`; t=30, env=E))
    sleep(3)
    push!(res, "ps" => sh(`ps -eo pid,etime,cmd`; t=10)[1:min(end,800)])
    julia = joinpath(Sys.BINDIR, "julia")
    code = "using CUDA; x=CUDA.ones(4); println(\"SUM=\", sum(x))"
    push!(res, "cuda1" => sh(`$julia --startup-file=no -e $code`; t=150, env=E))

    sleep(2)
    for f in ("control.log", "server.log")
